protocol: CPU postprocessing of immutable cached nodes with frozen MEGA-trained readouts; zero-shot transfer without NLI fitting or selection

uncertainty.grouping: native base family within each official split
uncertainty.qualification: Family cluster intervals account for derived variants sharing a base. Different families can still share trial material; these are not asserted independent trial sources.

interpretation.preserving: Released base/variant labels are equal; score differences are descriptive native NLI variation, not automatically a MEGA A/P invariance target.
interpretation.changing: Released base/variant labels differ; signed responses use right_label-left_label, without inferring a label flip from intervention names.
interpretation.ratio: difference_rms_ratio is method pair RMS / raw pair RMS. mean_signed_response_retention is reported only for true label-changing pairs, with its raw signed denominator.
interpretation.warning: Native Contradiction and Numerical_contradiction names include both same-label and flipping-label records.
